post.title: Obsidian wants $5 a month to sync. Cairn Notes doesn't.
post.caption: Four fresh grudges: a sync fee for your own notes, a baby tracker that went paid, five finance app bills and a paid Mac download manager. All rebuilt for free.

segments.quote: Obsidian made me pay them for syncing so I made an open-source implementation
